Definition: from G2596 and G3004 (in its original meaning); to lay down, i.e. (figuratively) to enrol:--take into the number.
BiblicalUsage: A widow is to be taken into the number only if she is not under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the church's care was ordered, not careless, and honour was given where a life had earned it.
